from pathlib import Path
import runpy,shutil,sys,tarfile
root=Path('/workspace'); root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
with tarfile.open(fileobj=sys.stdin.buffer,mode='r|') as archive:
    archive.extractall(root,filter='data')
import os
os.chdir(root)
scope='docs/verification/nearest-goals-close-20261031/regression'
module=runpy.run_path(str(root/scope/'run_docker_backend.py'))
inner=module['inner']; out=root/scope/'docker-attempt3';out.mkdir(parents=True)
inner.__globals__['ATTEMPT']=out

import subprocess
(root/'delegation_diag_plugin.py').write_text("\nimport functools,json,traceback\nfrom pathlib import Path\ndef pytest_configure(config):\n    from src.services.agent_delegation import AgentDelegations\n    for name in ('_observe_child','_finish'):\n        original=getattr(AgentDelegations,name)\n        def decorate(fn,label):\n            @functools.wraps(fn)\n            def observed(*args,**kwargs):\n                try:return fn(*args,**kwargs)\n                except Exception as error:\n                    record={'method':label,'type':type(error).__name__,'exception':str(error),\n                            'traceback':traceback.format_exc()}\n                    path=Path('/workspace/output/delegation-diagnostics.jsonl')\n                    with path.open('a',encoding='utf-8') as stream:stream.write(json.dumps(record)+'\\n')\n                    raise\n            return observed\n        setattr(AgentDelegations,name,decorate(original,name))\n",encoding='utf-8')
original_run=subprocess.run
def diagnosed(argv,*args,**kwargs):
    if isinstance(argv,list) and '-m' in argv and 'pytest' in argv:
        argv=[*argv,'--showlocals','--tb=long','-p','delegation_diag_plugin']
        kwargs['env']=dict(kwargs.get('env',os.environ),PYTHONPATH=str(root))
    return original_run(argv,*args,**kwargs)
subprocess.run=diagnosed

code=inner()
shutil.copytree(out,'/results',dirs_exist_ok=True)

diagnostic=root/'output/delegation-diagnostics.jsonl'
if diagnostic.exists():shutil.copyfile(diagnostic,'/results/delegation-diagnostics.jsonl')
for folder in (root/'output/ngd1/triage').glob('test_no_parent_grant*'):
    if folder.is_dir():shutil.copytree(folder,Path('/results')/'failed-fixture'/folder.name,dirs_exist_ok=True)

if code==0:
    for name in ('README.md','README_DETAILS.md'):
        shutil.copyfile(root/name,Path('/results')/(name+'.generated'))
raise SystemExit(code)
